about: Banter: exchanges between the voices, each a few turns of [voice, text], for quiet passages (lull) and quiet overs ending (betweenOvers). Never over a wicket, a boundary or a finish. The one who opens is never the over's caller; the caller may answer.

exchanges: THAT'S DRINKS, BY THE LOOK OF IT. I COULD MURDER A CUP OF TEA.
YOU SAID THAT AN HOUR AGO, BILL. AND YOU HAD ONE.
I'VE BEEN WATCHING THE FIELD SETTINGS. FASCINATING STUFF.
YOU'VE BEEN WATCHING THE PIE STAND, TONY.
A QUIET OVER. ONE OF THE GAME'S UNDERRATED PLEASURES.
QUIET FOR YOU, RICHIE. BILL'S BEEN SHOUTING AT A PIGEON.
LOOK AT THE CROWD! THEY'RE DOING THE WAVE!
SO THEY ARE. IT'S COME ROUND TWICE AND MISSED US BOTH TIMES.
IN MY DAY WE BOWLED TWENTY OVERS BEFORE LUNCH.
IN YOUR DAY THE BALL WAS STITCHED BY HAND, TONY!
THE UMPIRE HAS CHANGED HIS HAT.
RICHIE, THAT'S THE MOST EXCITING THING YOU'VE SAID ALL DAY!
I'VE GOT A GOOD FEELING ABOUT THE NEXT OVER!
YOU SAID THAT ABOUT THE LAST SIX, BILL.
THEY'LL BE CHECKING THE BALL. IT'S GONE A LITTLE SOFT.

turns: THE MUSIC'S UP BETWEEN OVERS! I LOVE IT!
I'D LOVE IT TOO, BILL, IF I COULD HEAR MYSELF THINK.
A LOVELY DAY FOR IT. THE SHADOWS, THE QUIET.
THE QUIET! RICHIE, I'VE BEEN ASLEEP SINCE TEA!
THE NEW BALL'S DUE SOON. THAT'LL CHANGE THINGS.
TONY, EVERY BALL CHANGES THINGS FOR YOU!

exchanges: THE GROUNDSMAN HAS MOWED A NEW STRIPE, I SEE.
DID YOU SEE THAT CATCH IN THE CROWD?! ONE HAND!
HE DROPPED HIS PIE TO TAKE IT, BILL. PRIORITIES.
I'D HAVE A SHORT LEG IN FOR THIS BATTER.
YOU'D HAVE A SHORT LEG IN FOR EVERYONE, TONY.
THE SCOREBOARD OPERATOR HAS HAD A BUSY OVER.
HE'S EARNED A CUP OF TEA, THAT FELLOW!
I'VE BEEN TO A LOT OF GROUNDS, BUT THIS ONE'S SPECIAL!
YOU SAY THAT ABOUT EVERY GROUND, BILL.
THE CAPTAIN'S HAVING A WORD WITH HIS BOWLER. I'D LOVE TO HEAR IT.
A PERFECTLY ORDINARY OVER. THE GAME NEEDS THEM.
ORDINARY?! RICHIE, I WAS ON THE EDGE OF MY SEAT!
THE CROWD'S IN GREAT VOICE TODAY!
THEY'RE SINGING ABOUT YOUR HAT, BILL.
I KNEW IT WAS A GOOD HAT!
I PLAYED ON THIS GROUND YEARS AGO. IT WAS QUICKER THEN.

turns: LOOK AT THE DANCERS! WHAT ENERGY!
THEY'VE DONE MORE RUNNING THAN THE BATTERS, BILL.
THE MIDDLE OVERS ARE WHERE A T20 IS WON. NOBODY BELIEVES ME.
I BELIEVE YOU, TONY! I JUST PREFER THE SIXES!
TEA IS NOT FAR AWAY. ONE CAN SENSE IT.
I CAN SMELL THE SCONES FROM HERE!
THIS IS PROPER CRICKET. FIVE DAYS, WHITE CLOTHES.
AND FIVE DAYS OF YOU TELLING US ABOUT IT, TONY!
FIFTY OVERS! THE PERFECT LENGTH FOR A GAME!
AND FOR A LONG LUNCH, BILL. WHICH IS WHY YOU LIKE IT.

exchanges: THAT'S THE BOWLERS WINNING, BILL. QUIETLY.
THE PIGEONS AT FINE LEG HAVEN'T MOVED IN AN HOUR.
THEY'RE BETTER AT LEAVING THAN SOME BATTERS I KNOW!
DOT, DOT, DOT. SOMEONE HAS TO BREAK THIS.
FORTY. ONE OF THEM IS A CRISP PACKET, BILL.

turns: SOME OF US ARE GETTING OLDER WATCHING IT.
THREE DOTS IN A ROW IN A T20! THE CROWD'S RESTLESS!
SO IS THE BATTER. THAT'S WHEN THE MISTAKE COMES.

exchanges: THE BOWLERS ARE BUILDING SOMETHING. YOU HAVE TO BE PATIENT.
I'M PATIENT, TONY! I'M JUST PATIENT LOUDLY!
THE BATTERS SEEM CONTENT. THE BOWLERS SEEM CONTENT.
I THINK THAT MAN IN THE CROWD IS ASLEEP!
HE'S WATCHING CLOSELY, BILL. WITH HIS EYES SHUT.
THIS IS A CHESS MATCH NOW.
I WAS NEVER ANY GOOD AT CHESS!
THE CALM BEFORE THE STORM, RICHIE! MARK MY WORDS!
WAKE ME UP WHEN SOMETHING HAPPENS!
SOMETHING IS HAPPENING, BILL. IT'S CALLED BOWLING.

turns: THE BALL'S GONE SOFT. THE BATTERS ARE HAPPY TO WAIT FOR THE NEW ONE.
QUIET, FOR A T20. ALMOST RESTFUL.
DON'T SAY THAT, RICHIE! YOU'LL JINX IT!

exchanges: THEY'RE PLAYING FOR A DRINKS BREAK, I THINK.
SO AM I, TONY! SO AM I!
